module.name: menubar
module.title: Menubar
module.description: The Menubar renderer and its options.

ui.name: menubar
ui.summary: Renders application menus as a row of disclosure buttons.
ui.guidance: Each menu is a DropdownMenu, so the whole bar inherits one behaviour: click or Enter to open, Escape to close, focus into the panel and back to the trigger. A real ARIA menubar adds cross-menu arrow navigation and typeahead; building half of that and claiming role="menubar" would promise a keyboard contract the widget does not honour.
ui.keyboard: Click or Enter opens a menu and Escape closes it, with focus moving into the panel and back to the trigger; there is deliberately no cross-menu arrow navigation.
